-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Mark of Megicula's Curse.png  |title= Curse-Warding Magic |kanji= 呪符魔法 |romaji= Jufu Mahō |english= Curse-Warding Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Megicula #Vanica Zogratis }} {{Nihongo|Curse-Warding Magic |呪符魔法|Jufu Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to create powerful curses.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to create powerful curses which they can cast on themselves and others. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full pote
    These curses can be either harmful or beneficial and can have various effects: deteriorating a person's body, continually resurrecting a person, weakening and disabling enemy spells, detonating a person's magic power, hi
    The curses' power and effects can be cut off by defeating the user or placing the user in a space that separates them from the world.{{Clr}}
